descriptions.zh: 高齡者過低比過高更危險（姿勢性低血壓→跌倒→骨折）。收縮壓 130–139 刻意由警示降為正常，低側門檻同步提高而非降低。
descriptions.id: Pada lansia, terlalu rendah lebih berbahaya daripada terlalu tinggi (hipotensi ortostatik→jatuh→patah tulang). Sistolik 130–139 sengaja diturunkan dari peringatan menjadi normal, sementara batas sisi rendah justru dinaikkan.
descriptions.en: For older adults, too low is more dangerous than too high (orthostatic hypotension → fall → fracture). Systolic 130–139 is deliberately downgraded from a warning to normal, while the low-side threshold is raised rather than lowered.
